verdict.rationale: Chronicle's documented scorers run only on tasks and trials inside simulated, frozen environments: backtests, suite runs and version comparisons. Production traces can be ingested via SDK or OpenTelemetry, but they are turned into tasks or replayed in staging rather than scored live. The marketing claim of 'real-time monitoring of production agents' is an adjacent monitoring feature with no evidence that evaluators or scorers run continuously on live traffic.
